summary: Daily briefing 24 juin: Semiconductor carnage — MU -13.2% from ATH ahead of today's earnings. SOXX -7.88%, NVDA -4.1%. Defensive rotation: XLP +1.87%, XLV +1.41%, KRE +1.57%. VIX surged +12.8% to 19.49, near crisis threshold. Regime score 30.3, crisis probability 29.9%. Core PCE + Russell Recon Friday = double catalyst.

risks.label: MU -13.2% crash — earnings today AMC, binary outcome
risks.detail: Micron crashed from ATH $1,211 to $1,052 (-13.2%) ahead of today's Q3 earnings (AMC). EPS est $20.66. After KOSPI circuit breaker, a miss would trigger second leg down in global semis. A beat with strong HBM guidance = relief rally.

risks.label: Crisis probability 29.9% — approaching regime flip
risks.detail: Ensemble model: early_risk_off 32.2% (dominant), crisis 29.9% (nearly doubled from 16.8%), neutral 26.0%, risk_on 11.9%. Regime score 30.3. If crisis > 35%, regime flips to confirmed CRISIS. MU earnings = the pivot.

risks.label: KOSPI circuit breaker fallout — global semi contagion
risks.detail: KOSPI -10% circuit breaker (Samsung -11%, SK Hynix -12%). US followed: SOXX -7.88%, SMH -7.01%, XLK -4.14%. KOSPI bounced +1.33% Wed but recovery fragile. Seoul regulators monitoring short-selling.

risks.label: VIX 19.49 — within striking distance of 20 threshold
risks.detail: VIX surged +12.8% to 19.49, touched 20.54 intraday. A sustained close above 20 = volatility regime change confirming crisis. 50D avg at 17.75. Watch for continuation Wed/Thu.

risks.label: Core PCE Friday — double catalyst with Russell Recon
risks.detail: May Core PCE (Fed's preferred inflation gauge) drops Friday Jun 27. Hot print (>0.3% MoM) = 10Y past 4.60% + crisis acceleration. Coincides with Russell Reconstitution = extreme gamma conditions.

risks.label: Multi-asset capitulation — even safe havens selling
risks.detail: SPX -1.44%, NASDAQ -2.21%, gold -1.70%, silver -1.56%, BTC -1%, oil -0.82%. When everything sells simultaneously, it signals forced liquidation and liquidity withdrawal. Classic late-cycle capitulation.

risks.label: Iran-Hormuz standoff — Day 4
risks.detail: Standoff continues. Oil falling as market calls bluff, but physical blockade risk remains. Escalation = Brent $95-100+ immediately. Monitor US Central Command.

risks.label: USD/JPY 161.55 — BOJ intervention threshold
risks.detail: Approaching level that triggered intervention in 2024. If BOJ acts, expect 3-5% yen spike and Nikkei selloff. Watch for verbal jawboning from Japanese officials.

risks.label: 10Y yield 4.49% — bear steepening dynamic
risks.detail: Yields eased slightly on flight-to-quality. 30Y near 5%. Bear steepening (long rates rising faster than short) signals growth-inflation collision. Above 4.60% = accelerated tech selloff.

events.label: MU (Micron) earnings TODAY AMC — THE event
events.detail: Q3 EPS est $20.66. After -13.2% crash, bar is reset lower. HBM guidance is key. Strong HBM = AI supercycle intact = relief rally. Weak HBM = sector capitulation below $900.

events.label: GDP Q1 Final + Durable Goods Thursday
events.detail: GDP final revision and durable goods orders drop Thursday. Negative GDP revision = cyclical selling acceleration. Strong durables = capex resilience signal.

events.label: Russell Reconstitution Friday Jun 27
events.detail: Annual index rebalance. 237 additions to R2000. Highest-volume day of the year. Collides with PCE = extreme gamma. IWM near 52W high.

events.label: PCE + Russell Recon = double-catalyst Friday
events.detail: Fed's preferred inflation gauge + year's biggest rebalance on same day. Hot PCE (>0.3% MoM) + index rebalancing = extreme volatility. Position sizing must account for Friday gamma.

events.label: PAYX + TCOM earnings today BMO
events.detail: Paychex Q4 (payroll, employment read). Trip.com Q1 (Chinese travel demand). Both pre-market Wednesday.

opportunities.label: XLV — Healthcare ETF, defensive rotation leader
opportunities.detail: +1.41% vs SPX -1.44% on capitulation day. Near 52W high. Entry $152, stop $147, TP1 $158, TP2 $162. R/R 2.0. Regime-insensitive, demographics tailwind.

opportunities.label: MRK — Best value pharma at PE 12.5x (Score 86)
opportunities.detail: +3.6% vs SPX -1.4%. Lowest fwd PE in pharma. 4/4 EPS beats. Entry $119.50, stop $114.50, TP1 $129.50. Keytruda franchise dominance.

regime_blips.label: Crisis probability nearly doubled to 29.9%
regime_blips.detail: From 16.8% to 29.9% in two sessions. Fastest acceleration since the Iran war onset in March. If MU misses earnings, crisis probability likely crosses 35% threshold = full CRISIS regime.

regime_blips.label: Healthcare vs Market divergence widest in months
regime_blips.detail: Healthcare (XLV +1.4%) outperformed NASDAQ (-2.21%) by 3.6%. JNJ/MRK outperformed SPX by 5%. Widest defensive rotation gap since COVID, confirming regime shift to defensive leadership.

regime_blips.label: VIX structure change — complacency to fear
regime_blips.detail: VIX: 17.28 → 19.49 (+12.8%), touched 20.54 intraday. 50D avg 17.75. Sustained above 20 = volatility regime change. VIX term structure likely shifting to backwardation.

regime_blips.label: Sector rotation extreme: 10% spread winners vs losers
regime_blips.detail: XLP (+1.87%) vs SOXX (-7.88%) = 9.75% single-day spread. This magnitude of sector divergence has historically preceded regime transitions. Institutions repositioning aggressively.

regime_blips.label: DXY at new 52W high — dollar strength headwind
regime_blips.detail: DXY at 101.49, new 52W high. Strong dollar pressures EM, commodities, gold, and US multinationals. Driven by US-Japan/EU rate differential and flight to safety.
